text:
[REGULAR ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Regular Items 11 - 16]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of Amendments to certain Concession Agreements with [i] The Hertz Corporation, [ii] Avis Rent-A-Car System LLC, [iii] Budget Rent-A-Car System Inc., [iv] Alamo Rental (US) LLC, [v] National Rental (US) LLC, [vi] DTG Operations Inc. dba Dollar Rent-A-Car, [vii] Enterprise Rent-A-Car Company of Los Angeles LLC, [viii] Fox Rent-A-Car Inc., [ix] DTG Operations Inc. dba Thrifty Car Rental, and [x] Sixt Rent-A-Car LLC: To extend their respective terms by twelve (12) months, covering rental car services at Los Angeles International Airport (Jean-Pierre Tabet)
summary: Extends the terms of ten rental car concession agreements at LAX by 12 months, including those held by Hertz, Avis, Enterprise and Sixt.

locations.text: Los Angeles International Airport, Los Angeles, CA

details.action: amendments to concession agreements (12-month term extension)
details.applicant: Hertz Corporation and nine other rental car concessionaires
